# 📊 End-to-End E-Commerce Sales & Customer Analytics

## 🧠 Problem Statement

This project aims to analyze e-commerce transaction data to identify key drivers of revenue, understand customer behavior, and evaluate delivery performance. The goal is to generate actionable insights that can improve business decision-making and customer satisfaction.

---

## 🎯 Objectives

* Analyze sales performance and revenue trends
* Identify top products and categories
* Understand customer behavior and retention
* Evaluate delivery performance and delays
* Provide business recommendations

---

## 📁 Dataset Description

The dataset contains multiple tables related to an e-commerce platform, including:

* Customers
* Orders
* Order Items
* Payments
* Reviews
* Products
* Sellers

These datasets are combined to perform a comprehensive analysis.

---

## 🛠️ Tools Used

* Python (Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn)
* SQL
* Excel
* Power BI

---
